Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Referred Sections: CMM-609.7: Lumbar Fusion (with or without Decompression) Following Failed Lumbar Disc Arthroplasty Surgery
CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct)

Required findings: Post-operative imaging shows evidence of lumbar disc arthroplasty implant malposition or failure (e.g., subsidence, loosening, infection, dislocation, subluxation, vertebral body fracture, dislodgement)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.7: Lumbar Fusion (with or without Decompression) Following Failed Lumbar Disc Arthroplasty Surgery > Failed Lumbar Disc Arthroplasty Implant (TOC: S10.1.1)

Required findings: Greater than six (6) months since the prior lumbar total disc arthroplasty at the same level
Post-operative MRI/CT shows evidence of neural structure compression (e.g., either retained disc material or a recurrent disc herniation)
Criteria have been met in the applicable procedure-specific section (CMM-609.4 or CMM-609.5)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.7: Lumbar Fusion (with or without Decompression) Following Failed Lumbar Disc Arthroplasty Surgery > Evidence of Neural Structure Compression (TOC: S10.1.2)

Required findings: The individual is a candidate for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608: Lumbar Decompression

Imaging findings include degenerative spondylolisthesis without spondylolysis with dynamic segmental instability (>3mm translational alignment difference) or Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis

Imaging findings include spondylolisthesis with spondylolysis with Meyerding Grade I/II progression, Grade III+ with ≥50% slippage, progressive pain without confirmatory imaging, multi-level spondylolysis, post-operative instability from facet excision (>50% bilateral or ≥75% single), pars fracture, or iatrogenic spondylolisthesis
Documentation of nicotine-free status (never-smoker or 6 weeks abstinence validated by objective cotinine testing)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct) > Actual Instability (TOC: S7.1.1)

Required findings: The individual is a candidate for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608: Lumbar Decompression

Anticipated iatrogenic instability created by facet joint excision (>50% bilateral or ≥75% single), removal of pars interarticularis, decompression for Meyerding Grade I+ spondylolisthesis with foraminal stenosis, or complete/partial corpectomy (removal of ≥1/3 vertebral body)
Documentation of nicotine-free status (never-smoker or 6 weeks abstinence validated by objective cotinine testing)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct) > Anticipated Iatrogenic Instability (TOC: S7.1.2)

Required findings: The individual is a candidate for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608: Lumbar Decompression

Imaging findings include coronal plane deformity (Cobb angle >30°, asymmetric disk collapse, or global coronal imbalance) OR sagittal imbalance (sagittal vertebral axis >8cm or pelvic incidence-lumbar lordosis >15°)
Documentation of nicotine-free status (never-smoker or 6 weeks abstinence validated by objective cotinine testing)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct) > Adult Symptomatic Degenerative Spinal Deformity (TOC: S7.1.3)

Required findings: The individual is a candidate for an initial primary lumbar discectomy per CMM-606.2 or CMM-606.1

Advanced imaging shows primary extraforaminal disc herniation at L5-S1 where far lateral approach is not feasible due to iliac wings, primary foraminal disc herniation requiring facet resection causing iatrogenic instability, or primary disc herniation at the level of the spinal cord (low lying conus medullaris)
Documentation of nicotine-free status (never-smoker or 6 weeks abstinence validated by objective cotinine testing)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct) > Initial Disc Herniation (TOC: S7.1.4)

Required findings: The individual is a candidate for repeat lumbar discectomy per CMM-606.3

Imaging findings include evidence of anterolisthesis at the requested level(s) resulting in dynamic segmental instability (>3mm translational alignment difference) or Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis
Documentation of nicotine-free status (never-smoker or 6 weeks abstinence validated by objective cotinine testing)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct) > Recurrent Disc Herniation (TOC: S7.1.5)

Medical necessity indications.Guideline Category: Second or Greater Recurrent Disc Herniation
Required findings: The individual is a candidate for repeat lumbar discectomy per CMM-606.3
Documentation of nicotine-free status (never-smoker or 6 weeks abstinence validated by objective cotinine testing)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct) > Second or Greater Recurrent Disc Herniation (TOC: S7.1.6)

Required findings: Imaging findings include dynamic segmental instability (>3mm translational alignment difference) or Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis at the requested level(s)
Symptoms include significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing)

Less than clinically meaningful improvement with prescription strength analgesics/steroids/gabapentinoids/NSAIDs OR provider-directed exercise program for at least three (3) consecutive months (unless contraindicated)
Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)
Documentation of nicotine-free status (never-smoker or 6 weeks abstinence validated by objective cotinine testing)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.5: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression > Degenerative Spondylolisthesis without Spondylolysis (TOC: S8.1.1)

Required findings: Imaging findings include Meyerding Grade I/II spondylolisthesis with progression, Meyerding Grade III+ with ≥50% slippage or progression, progressive spinal pain without confirmatory imaging, or multi-level spondylolysis
Symptoms include significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing)

Less than clinically meaningful improvement with prescription strength analgesics/steroids/gabapentinoids/NSAIDs OR provider-directed exercise program for at least three (3) consecutive months (unless contraindicated)
Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)
Documentation of nicotine-free status (never-smoker or 6 weeks abstinence validated by objective cotinine testing)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.5: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression > Spondylolisthesis with Spondylolysis (e.g., Isthmic Spondylolisthesis) (TOC: S8.1.2)

Medical necessity indications.Guideline Category: Discogenic Lower Back Pain/Degenerative Disc Disease
Required findings: Plain x-rays and advanced imaging (CT, MRI) show moderate to severe single-level disc degeneration at the requested level(s)
Presence of chronic, unremitting, discogenic axial lower back pain and associated disability secondary to single-level degenerative lumbar disc disease (DDD) for at least one year
Symptoms include significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing)
Structured physician-supervised, multi-modal, nonoperative management with regularly scheduled appointments and follow-up evaluation

Less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following (unless contraindicated): prescription strength analgesics/steroids/gabapentinoids/NSAIDs for at least 12 consecutive months, provider-directed exercise program for at least 12 consecutive months, epidural steroid injection(s)/selective nerve root block(s) at the same level(s), or facet joint injection(s)/medial branch block(s)/radiofrequency ablation(s)
Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)
Documentation of nicotine-free status (never-smoker or 6 weeks abstinence validated by objective cotinine testing)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.5: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression > Discogenic Lower Back Pain/Degenerative Disc Disease (TOC: S8.1.3)

Required findings: Imaging findings include coronal plane deformity (Cobb angle >30°, asymmetric disk collapse, or global coronal imbalance) OR sagittal imbalance (sagittal vertebral axis >8cm or pelvic incidence-lumbar lordosis >15°)

Less than clinically meaningful improvement with prescription strength analgesics/steroids/gabapentinoids/NSAIDs OR provider-directed exercise program for at least three (3) consecutive months (unless contraindicated)
Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)
Documentation of nicotine-free status (never-smoker or 6 weeks abstinence validated by objective cotinine testing)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.5: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression > Adult Symptomatic Degenerative Spinal Deformity (TOC: S8.1.4)

Non-Indications: Lumbar fusion following failed lumbar disc arthroplasty performed less than six (6) months after the prior lumbar total disc arthroplasty at the same level
Lumbar fusion for failed lumbar disc arthroplasty without post-operative imaging evidence of implant malposition/failure or neural structure compression
Lumbar fusion for degenerative spondylolisthesis without spondylolysis lacking dynamic segmental instability (>3mm) or Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis

Lumbar fusion for spondylolisthesis with spondylolysis lacking specific imaging criteria (e.g., Meyerding Grade I/II without progression, Grade III+ without ≥50% slippage or progression, or multi-level spondylolysis)

Lumbar fusion for discogenic lower back pain/degenerative disc disease with less than one year of chronic, unremitting pain or failure to complete structured multi-modal nonoperative management for at least 12 consecutive months

Lumbar fusion for any indication in the presence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)

Lumbar fusion for any indication in patients who have not refrained from smoking, smokeless tobacco, or nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to surgery, or who fail objective cotinine testing
Lumbar fusion for adult symptomatic degenerative spinal deformity without documented coronal plane deformity (Cobb >30°, etc.) or sagittal imbalance (SVA >8cm, PI-LL >15°)
Important criteria & exceptions: When instability is created and/or identified intra-operatively, the pre-operative imaging criteria for Actual Instability are NOT required
For Discogenic Lower Back Pain/Degenerative Disc Disease, conservative management must include regularly scheduled appointments and follow-up evaluation in addition to the specific therapeutic trials
Nicotine-free status must be validated by objective cotinine testing methods (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range for the testing method and lab
Criteria for 'Evidence of Neural Structure Compression' following failed arthroplasty require meeting the criteria in the applicable procedure-specific section (CMM-609.4 or CMM-609.5)
Documentation required: Post-operative imaging (MRI/CT) showing evidence of lumbar disc arthroplasty implant malposition or failure (subsidence, loosening, infection, dislocation, subluxation, vertebral body fracture, dislodgement)
Post-operative MRI/CT showing evidence of neural structure compression (retained disc material or recurrent disc herniation)
Dynamic segmental instability imaging (flexion-extension plain x-rays OR comparison of supine and upright image) showing >3mm translational alignment difference
Plain x-rays supporting progression of anterolisthesis or showing Meyerding Grade II/III+ spondylolisthesis
Advanced imaging (CT, MRI) showing moderate to severe single-level disc degeneration

Imaging demonstrating coronal plane deformity (Cobb angle >30°, asymmetric disk collapse, global coronal imbalance) or sagittal imbalance (sagittal vertebral axis >8cm, pelvic incidence-lumbar lordosis >15°)
Objective cotinine testing results (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within normal range, or documentation of never-smoker status
Records of structured physician-supervised, multi-modal, nonoperative management including regularly scheduled appointments and follow-up evaluation
Documentation of prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or NSAIDs usage for required duration (3 or 12 months)
Provider-directed exercise program records (prescribed by physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician) for required duration
Records of epidural steroid injection(s), selective nerve root block(s), facet joint injection(s), medial branch block(s), or radiofrequency ablation(s) at the same level(s) as requested surgery
Documentation of absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders
